blocks.content: A silence temporarily suppresses notifications for alerts that match specific labels. Alert evaluation continues normally during a silence, but no notifications are sent. This is useful during planned maintenance, known outages, or while troubleshooting.
To navigate to the Silences page, complete the following steps:
In Grafana Cloud, navigate to **Alerts & IRM > Alerting > Silences**.
The Silences page shows all active and expired silences. If this is your first silence, the list will be empty.
In the next milestone, you'll create a silence with label matchers.
